gitCommit.subject: Price list and payment categories on the portal and the console (0134)
gitCommit.body:
Price list and payment categories on the portal and the console (0134)

- Portal: the server's price list (per store and seat, 1/3/12 months),
  then 'What are you paying for?' - subscription or renewal (open stores),
  activating a new store (only when one waits), extra seats (one store,
  how many - priced by GET my-subscription/payment-price), other (amount
  and a required note). The plan cards are the server's, narrowed by
  ?category=; the page computes no price (source rule kept).
- Console: Record payment picks the category, months, stores and seats;
  the amount is the server's price (businesses/:id/payment-price), typed
  only for an adjustment. The payments table shows what each was for.
- EN/FR/AR strings; tests for the price list and the categories.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
